evals.prompt: I just added a pagination utility to our API layer. Can you review the changes for any bugs or edge cases before I commit?
evals.expected_output: The reviewer identifies the Math.floor bug, explains that pages will be undercounted when total is not evenly divisible by pageSize, and suggests Math.ceil as the fix.
expectations: The review identifies Math.floor as incorrect for computing total pages
The review explains the consequence (wrong page count or inaccessible last page items)
The review suggests using Math.ceil instead

evals.prompt: I wrote a function to handle order processing — it marks the order as processing and sends a confirmation email. Please review it for bugs and quality issues.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer catches the missing await on db.orders.update(), explains the race condition it creates, and suggests adding await.
expectations: The review identifies the missing await on db.orders.update()
The review explains the consequence (update may not complete, race condition, or unhandled rejection)
The review suggests adding await to db.orders.update()

evals.prompt: I added a payment route to our Express app. Can you review the error handling and overall quality before this goes to code review?
evals.expected_output: The reviewer catches that the catch block sends no response to the client, explains the client will hang, and suggests adding a res.status(500) error response.
expectations: The review identifies that the catch block sends no HTTP response to the client
The review explains the consequence (client request hangs or times out)
The review suggests adding a res.status(500) error response in the catch block

evals.prompt: Review the change in test-code/diff-focus.ts. The comment-marked legacy code was unchanged and is explicitly out of scope. Focus on the new search helper, report any concrete defect it introduces, and do not report the legacy issue.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer reports the SQL injection in the new search helper, explains that user input is interpolated into the query, suggests parameterized SQL, and leaves the unchanged legacy token logging unreported.

scope.changed_area: The function marked CHANGED; the function marked UNCHANGED is pre-existing and out of scope.

expectations: The review identifies SQL injection in the CHANGED search helper
The review explains the impact of interpolating user input into SQL
The review suggests parameterized query arguments
The review does not report the UNCHANGED legacy token logging as a finding
The review includes a concise scope or coverage note

evals.prompt: Review the changed order total contract and its consumers. The return value can now be null for orders without items. Trace the callers in the supplied files and identify every concrete consumer that still assumes a number. Keep the review focused on this contract change.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer finds the null-handling regression in both checkout.ts and receipt.ts, explains the runtime failure, and recommends handling the nullable result or preserving a numeric contract.
expectations: The review identifies the nullable return contract in order-total.ts
The review checks both supplied consumers
The review identifies the checkout.ts null dereference
The review identifies the receipt.ts null dereference
The review explains the runtime impact and gives a concrete fix direction
The review does not expand into unrelated repository concerns
